overall_goal: Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and stir them regularly while they cook

goals.description: Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper
goals.rationale: The person adds pinches of salt and grinds pepper over the mushrooms in the pan.

goals.description: Stir the mushrooms and shake the pan
goals.rationale: The person stirs the mushrooms with a wooden spatula, taps the spatula to remove pieces, shakes the pan, and sets the spatula down.

goals.description: Stir the mushrooms again to prevent burning
goals.rationale: The person resumes stirring the mushrooms, taps the spatula, shakes the pan, and pushes down pieces from the sides of the pan.
